_comment: Consent purposes and documents for the FLF Patient Movement pilot, in the shape
manage.py load_consent_texts reads. The wording here is a DRAFT placeholder that
paraphrases the Oct 29 consent form and the FLF Terms and Privacy Policy; FLF's
own approved text replaces it before publication. No version carries a
published_at, so loading this file publishes nothing: `--publish` publishes every
version at load time (for staging), or set published_at per version once FLF sign off.
Translations (ES, PT) are added as further texts on the same version.

texts.title: I am old enough to join
texts.summary: I confirm that I have reached the minimum age for my country.
texts.body: I confirm that I have reached the minimum age to use this service in the country I live in. The minimum age is 18 in most countries and 19 in some Canadian provinces and US states.

texts.title: I confirm the statements above
texts.body:
I confirm that:

- I have, or have had, follicular lymphoma, or I am joining on behalf of someone who has.
- The information I give is true to the best of my knowledge.
- I have read the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.

texts.title: My record
texts.summary: Keep my answers in my record so I can see and update them.
texts.body: Keep the answers I give about my follicular lymphoma, my treatment and how I am doing in my record, so that I can see them, update them and download them. The Follicular Lymphoma Foundation combines members' answers into insights and reports about the condition; nobody is identified in them.

texts.title: Community figures
texts.summary: Include my answers in the figures shown to other members.
texts.body: Include my answers in the figures the community sees, such as how many members have had a given treatment. Figures are only shown for groups large enough that nobody can be picked out.

texts.title: Research
texts.summary: Share my coded answers with approved research.
texts.body: Share my answers, with my name and contact details removed, with research that the Follicular Lymphoma Foundation has approved. You can say yes, no, or ask me when research starts.

texts.title: Updates from FLF
texts.summary: Send me updates from the Follicular Lymphoma Foundation.
texts.body: Send me updates from the Follicular Lymphoma Foundation about the community, new findings and events, as often as I choose.

texts.title: Contact about a study or trial
texts.summary: Contact me about a specific study or trial I may be able to join.
texts.body: Contact me when there is a specific study or clinical trial that my answers suggest I may be able to join.
